features.name: Grave Domain
features.desc: You sense living creatures on the verge of death and Undead within 30 feet. A target at full Hit Points can't regain Hit Points.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.desc: As a Reaction, you halve the damage dealt to a creature within 30 feet. A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.desc: When an enemy dies near you, you heal a wounded ally within 30 feet for 4d10 (once per turn).
